ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram, what role do plants serve for consumers?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The top of the figure is labeled “Sunlight”, and arrows point respectively to the “Maize plant” on the left and the “Wheat plant” on the right. The maize plant is connected downward by arrows to “Corn for feeding chicken”, and then to chicken; the wheat plant is connected downward to wheat grains being milled into wheat flour, and together with chicken meat is used to make chicken pizza. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows indicate food or energy being transferred from the source to the organism/product that uses or consumes it. Plants first obtain sunlight energy, then provide food materials such as corn and wheat to chickens and consumers in the human food chain. Therefore, the role of plants for consumers is to provide an energy source.
